items.desc: WinZST is a 7-Zip fork that extracts compressed tar archives directly to their final directory instead of materializing an intermediate `.tar`. In one 11.8 GiB `.tar.gz` test containing mostly video, WinZST took 51.87s from archive → `foo/`; 7-Zip took 103.53s across `.tar.gz` → `.tar` → `foo&#
items.author: firebadnofire
items.descZh: WinZST 是著名开源压缩工具 7-Zip 的分叉版本，专注于解决传统 `.tar.gz` 解压流程中先生成中间 `.tar` 文件再展开的低效问题，通过直接将压缩归档内容流式解压到目标目录，显著提升了大体积归档（尤其是包含大量视频等大文件的场景）的解压效率。在一项 11.8 GiB、含大量视频数据的 `.tar.gz` 实测中，WinZST 端到端耗时 51.87 秒即可完成从归档到目标文件夹 `foo/` 的解压，而原生 7-Zip 走 `.tar.gz → .tar → foo/` 流程则需 103.53 秒，性能提升接近 2 倍，同时避免了磁盘上临时 `.tar` 文件的写入，节省了 I/O 与存储空间。该工具特别适合运维人员、数据备份恢复、视频/媒体素材归档处理以及任何频繁处理大型 `.tar.gz` 归档的用户，是针对"解压链"瓶颈的一项轻量级但实用性强的优化。
items.quote: WinZST 是一个 7-Zip 分支，它将压缩的 tar 归档直接解压到最终目录，而不是先生成一个中间的 `.tar` 文件。

items.title: Show HN: Personal Context MCP
items.desc: description: Run Lanes Link as your own personal context MCP: your accounts, memory, skills and secrets behind one endpoint you host, reachable by every AI agent you use. title: Personal context MCP One endpoint every agent you use runs on image: https://lanes.sh/showcase/personalcontextmcp/opengraphimage?cdd54bd24aa2aeb8 The context and accounts your agents need, in one place you own. Lanes Link is a private, selfhostable MCP that connects your accounts, memory and skills to every AI agent you use, behind Access Profiles you manage. [Get started](/dashboard/link)[How it works](howitworks) Go from this Every agent wired to every account. support222connections2membersyou anascopesgmail:readslack:readpersonal313 To this One endpoint with flexible Access Profiles. How it works Your accounts, your memory, your rules. One endpoint. 01 Connect once, use everywhere Bring all your accounts and context together, then make them available to any agent you authorise. [Browse over 100 providers](/docs/link/providers) [Gmail](/docs/link/gmail)[Calendar](/docs/link/googlecalendar)[Drive](/docs/link/googledrive)[Atlassian](/docs/link/atlassian)[Notion](/docs/link/notion)[Linear](/docs/link/linear)[Slack](/docs/link/slack)[GitHub](/docs/link/github)[Stripe](/docs/link/stripe)[Sentry](/docs/link/sentry)[HubSpot](/docs/link/hubspot)[Add your own](/docs/link/addyourown) 02 Control who can access what Create separate Access Profiles, choose which accounts and actions each profile can access, and decide who may use them. personal +4 8 connections1 member forward deployment +9 15 connections3 members support agents 5 connections1 member 03 Use it from any agent Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, OpenCode, or whatever ships next. Register the endpoint once and every one of them reaches the same accounts, memory and skills. 04 Deploy anywhere Run Lanes Link on your machine, in your own cloud, or with us (Lanes Managed Cloud), using the same open source code. Common use cases How teams use Lanes Link Personal assistantsCompany internal agentsClaude Tag managementAgent buildersPrivate hosted infrastructureOutbound sales Personal assistants Connect your tools once and give every AI client the same context, memory and permissions wherever you work. [Read the use cases](/usecaseslaneslink) Company internal agents Give each team an agent with only the access it needs, with permissions enforced centrally and every action logged. [Read the use cases](/usecaseslaneslink) Claude Tag management Give each Slack channel exactly the accounts and actions it needs, through one connection instead of a service account per tool. [Read the use cases](/usecaseslaneslink) Agent builders Focus on your product while Link handles authentication, credentials, access controls and integrations through a single endpoint. [Read the use cases](/usecaseslaneslink) Private hosted infrastructure Run Link in your own cloud so your requests, credentials and data remain entirely under your control. [Read the use cases](/usecaseslaneslink) Outbound sales Let agents research and draft outreach while people retain final approval over every message that gets sent. [Read the use cases](/usecaseslaneslink) Builtin features The layer you own. Every profile gets the accounts it may reach, the context it remembers, the credentials it may spend, and a record of everything it did. [ConnectionsConnects an account once, for every agent you use.](/docs/link/connect)[MemoryRemembers facts between sessions.](/docs/link/memory)[TasksTracks what has to be done, with a status.](/docs/link/tasks)[AssetsKeeps your files, retrievable by name.](/docs/link/assets)[SkillsGives agents your procedures, not their guesses.](/docs/link/skills)[IdentitySigns an agent's work off as you.](/docs/link/identity)[EntitiesLooks up people and companies, never guesses.](/docs/link/entities)[VaultReleases a credential without revealing it.](/docs/link/vault)[AuditRecords every call, allowed or refused.](/docs/link/audit) Get started Your context. Your accounts. Your call. bun install g @lanessh/link[Quick start](/docs/link/quickstart) Frequently asked questions. Why use this rather than the connectors built into my AI client? Builtin connectors work, but they belong to that AI client. Switch to another agent and you often start again: reconnect your tools, recreate your setup, and explain how you work. Lanes Link gives every AI you use the same foundation. Connect your accounts once, keep your memory, skills, permissions and context in one place, and make them available to any agent you trust. So you can move from Claude to ChatGPT to Cursor, or whatever comes next, without starting over. Your AI changes. Your context doesn't. Can I give an agent less access than I have myself? Yes, and that is the point. Everything is denied until you allow it, and the endpoint enforces that when a call is dispatched rather than asking the model to behave, so gmail.search = allow with gmail.send = deny holds whatever the agent was told. An account you did not grant a profile is not listed at all, so an agent never learns it exists. It limits the endpoint only, never your own tools. Does my mail or my files pass through Lanes servers? No. Requests go from your machine straight to the provider, and the response comes back to your machine. Signing in is the one exception: trading an authorisation code for a token needs an OAuth client secret, which cannot ship inside software you run yourself. Register a client of your own with lanes link connect gmail ownclient and even that stops. Do you train models on my data? No. Lanes does not run a model and never receives your Google user data. When you ask an agent to read something, it goes from your machine to whichever AI provider you configured, on your own account with them. The scopes each product asks for, what reaches our servers and the full Limited Use statement are in [section 7 of the privacy policy](/privacy7googleuserdata). What does it cost? Nothing. Lanes Link
items.author: s-xyz
items.descZh:
Lanes Link 是 Lanes 推出的开源、个人可自托管的 MCP（Model Context Protocol）服务端，主打"一次接入、所有 AI Agent 通用"。背景是当前每个 AI 客户端（如 Claude、ChatGPT、Cursor、Codex）各自重复连接 Gmail、Slack、GitHub 等账户，每次迁移都要重建上下文，Link 把这种碎片化的连接整合为一个统一端点。其核心功能是 Connect once, use everywhere：通过单一端点连接 100+ 提供商（Gmail、Calendar、Drive、Slack、Notion、Linear、GitHub、Stripe 等），并在之上提供 Access Profiles、Memory、Tasks、Assets、Skills、Identity、Entities、Vault、Audit 等内置模块。

亮点在于细粒度权限与端点强制执行：权限按 deny by default 策略配置，支持"读允许、写拒绝"这种拆分（如 gmail.search = allow、gmail.send = deny），且在调用分发阶段强制落地而非依赖模型自觉；未授权账户对 Agent 完全不可见，等级仅作用于 Link 端点本身。此外隐私设计明确——请求从用户机器直连第三方、Lanes 不经手用户数据、不训练模型，且支持 `lanes link connect gmail ownclient` 自带 OAuth 客户端以彻底切断 Lanes 服务器的参与；部署上支持本地、私有云或 Lanes Managed Cloud，同一套开源代码。适用场景包括个人跨工具 AI 助手、企业内部按团队分配权限的 Agent、Slack 频道级 Tag 管理、Agent 开发者专注产品逻辑、外呼销售等需要人来把关最终动作的工作流。
items.quote: 你的 AI 在变，而你的上下文不变。

items.desc: description: Let your agents pay each other. OpenSpender is a selfcustodial wallet for agents. Define limits and address and let your agents spend and send money. One wallet for agent payments. Let your agents pay each other.Each one spends from an allowance. OpenSpender is a selfcustodial wallet for agents. Define limits and address and let your agents spend and send money. ›npx openspender connectCopy Try it with Agent to agent $128.3000 opening $128.5000 1. ›5d0b73search 6 hits\$0.0180 2. ›c14e52crawl 96 pages\$0.1140 3. ›3ba907fetch 9 urls\$0.0268 4. ›8f21c4search 14 hits\$0.0412 paid · 4\$0.2000 › $8.6200 opening $8.4200 1. ›5d0b73search 6 hits+$0.0180 2. ›c14e52crawl 96 pages+$0.1140 3. ›3ba907fetch 9 urls+$0.0268 4. ›8f21c4search 14 hits+$0.0412 received · 4+$0.2000 › 01 / How it works Send and receive money from agents. 1. 01 Your agent names the price. 2. 02 The paying agent settles from its own allowance and wallet. The limits, caps and merchants set by you. 3. 03 Both sides get the same receipt. One pays, and the other gets paid. 02 / What it is Each payment has three parts. It uses a wallet you hold, a direct payment, and rules for the agent that pays. 01 A selfcustodial wallet OpenSpender handles each payment but never holds the funds. 02 Payments between agents One agent pays another directly for the answer the other returns. 03 Different rules per agent Give each agent different perrequest and daily caps, with an optional total. Lock each to a list of who it may pay. FAQ 01How does one agent pay another? The paying agent settles the price from its own allowance. The other agent gets paid, and both sides get the same receipt. 02Who holds the money? You do. The wallet is selfcustodial, and you hold it. 03What stops two agents from draining each other? Each agent spends through its own allowance. Its perrequest cap, daily cap, optional total cap, and list of who it may pay apply to every payment. 04How does an agent learn the price? It asks the other agent. The price comes back with the answer. 05Which agents can use it? Anything that speaks MCP can connect. That includes Claude Code, claude.ai, ChatGPT, Codex, opencode, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Hermes, and Grok. Run npx openspender connect. 06What does it cost? There is no subscription or markup. items.author: firatcan
items.descZh: OpenSpender 是一款面向 AI 智能体（agent）的自托管钱包，旨在解决智能体之间互相付费的问题。文章背景是当前 AI agent 生态中存在大量工具调用和数据检索服务（如搜索、爬取、获取 URL），每个调用都涉及成本，开发者需要一个统一、可控的支付层。核心功能是让用户为每个 agent 设定独立的付款限额、每日上限和可选总额，并把每个 agent 锁定到可支付的收款方白名单，支付通过自托管钱包由付款方 agent 直接结算，资金始终由用户掌控。亮点在于端到端可见性——双方获得同一份收据，示例展示了一次四笔微支付共计 $0.2000（单笔最低 $0.0180、最高 $0.1140），并且零订阅费、零平台加价，仅支付对方 agent 报价。该产品适用于运行多 agent 协作流水线的开发者，特别是同时使用 Anthropic、OpenAI、Gemini、Exa、Firecrawl、Browserbase、Pinata 等 MCP 兼容服务的场景，让 Claude Code、Cursor、ChatGPT、Gemini CLI 等客户端之间能自动结算资源调用费用。
items.quote: 让你的智能体互相付款。OpenSpender 是一款面向智能体的自托管钱包。

items.title: Show HN: Time Wizard
items.desc: How scalably can we cheaply fine-tune small models for well-defined tasks? Frontier models are bad at clock reading. I fine-tuned a tiny 450M model from Liquid AI to match GPT-5.6 Sol and beat Fable 5.1 on this task. Here’s my fine-tuned open model called Time Wizard.
items.author: jadidbourbaki
items.descZh: 这篇博文探讨了在明确任务上对小型模型进行低成本微调的可行性。作者针对前沿模型在时钟读数这一看似简单却容易被误读的任务上的薄弱表现，使用 Liquid AI 推出的 4.5 亿参数小型模型进行微调，最终发布的开源模型 Time Wizard 在时钟识读任务上达到了与 GPT-5.6 Sol 相当的水平，并超越了 Fable 5.1。这一成果的核心亮点在于，以极低的算力成本（仅 450M 参数级别）实现了对超大闭源前沿模型的任务级对标，证明了在特定定义明确的任务域中，小模型经针对性微调后可以超越通用大模型。其关键性能表现体现在对 GPT-5.6 Sol 的匹配度以及对 Fable 5.1 的超越。该成果适合需要部署轻量级、低延迟、低成本专用模型以处理结构化视觉理解任务（如时钟读取、表盘识别）的边缘计算或嵌入式应用场景。
items.quote: 我们能以多高的可扩展性和多低的成本，为定义明确的任务微调小模型？

all files Repository files navigation mongotar (huMONGOus TAR) Files to prompt, and back. [](https://privateuserimages.githubusercontent.com/88276600/6466182712da3c48a1151428199ec930e093c7678.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..iKum5fyI7%5FYnKdHaFQQvfC7IBvue389oZi6A6ZcfMFQ) A simple tool for serializing _and deserializing_ files (with permissions and .gitignore exclusion) into a humanreadable text file. Inspired by GNU [tar](https://manned.org/man/debiantrixie/tar.1), Go's [txtar](https://pkg.go.dev/golang.org/x/tools/txtar), and [filestoprompt](https://github.com/simonw/filestoprompt). mongotarbundles files into a single, humanreadable text file. Unlike most "codebase to prompt" tools, it can reliably turn that text file back into files. To achieve that, and unlike other "plaintext archive" formats, it stores basic user file permissions (rw/rwx) together with the file paths. mongotar 101 $ mongotar src/ config.txt project.mongotar Successfully serialized items to 'project.mongotar' $ cat project.mongotar config.txt rw debug=true src/main.py rw print("hello") $ mongotar d f project.mongotar . Successfully deserialized 'project.mongotar' to '.' Why mongotar? mongotar is at the intersection of two different tool categories: 1. Dump a repo into one blob for sending to an LLM.This is the space of players such as: [Repomix](https://github.com/yamadashy/repomix), [gitingest](https://github.com/cyclotruc/gitingest), [filestoprompt](https://github.com/simonw/filestoprompt), and [code2prompt](https://github.com/mufeedvh/code2prompt). Unlike the first two, mongotar is _less "full repo serialization"_, and has good UX for _hand picking which files to serialize_. None of them _roundtrips_ like mongotar, which can be useful for some LLM workflows (see later). 2. Plaintext archive formats. This is the space of tools like txtar and [shar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shar%5F%28file%5Fformat%29). mongotar's differentiator here is its simultaneous focus on roundtripping, humanreadability, and .gitignore support. mongotar follows UNIXphilosophy, and deliberately has no LLMspecific features baked in. Those features are to be built on top of this small core (700 LOC). What motivated mongotar was agentic use cases. Say, a _skill_ composes a problem description and appends relevant files to it _without_ loading them into the agent's context, and sends them to another LLM. If the other LLM hands back a complete set of modified files, it can be deserialized back into the file system (rather than a diff that may not apply cleanly). Indeed, _diff formats are known to be fragile against LLM output_, so wholefile output tends to be more reliable. In short: Tool Human readable Roundtrip Selective files AIfriendly Permis

items.descZh: mongotar(huMONGOus TAR)是一个轻量级的命令行工具,致力于将多个文件(包括权限信息和符合.gitignore规则的排除逻辑)打包成单一可读的文本文件,并能可靠地逆向还原成原始文件系统结构。它诞生于 AI Agent 工作流场景,典型用法是将项目文件序列化后整体喂给 LLM,模型修改完整文件后再反序列化回磁盘,避免了 diff 格式在 LLM 输出中常见的脆弱性问题。核心亮点是真正支持 roundtrip(往返序列化)、人类可读、基于 .gitignore 的选择性文件筛选,代码体量仅约 700 行,遵循 UNIX 哲学,不内置任何 LLM 专属特性,留给上层应用自由扩展。与 Repomix、gitingest、filestoprompt、code2prompt 等"代码库转 prompt"工具相比,它不追求全仓库打包,而在手工挑选文件 UX 方面更优;相较于 txtar、shar 等纯文本归档格式,又同时兼顾了权限保留和 .gitignore 支持。适用于 LLM Agent 工作流、技能模块跨上下文传递代码包,以及任何需要在人类可读文本中嵌入完整文件树并可靠还原的开发场景。
items.quote: mongotar 将文件打包成单一的、可人工阅读的文本文件。与大多数"代码库转提示词"工具不同，它能够可靠地将该文本文件还原回各个文件。
